verdict.rationale: Tavily has a public, self-serve pricing page built on API credits: 1,000 free credits per month with no credit card, and a pay-as-you-go model ("Pay only for what you use"). Usage and per-request log endpoints let developers track consumption, though that covers tracking rather than pricing. However, the evidence shows no actual per-credit price or per-request credit cost, so the pricing is only partly clear. Missing for 10: the per-credit dollar rate, credit cost per endpoint or request type, paid tier and volume pricing details, and independent confirmation that no sales contact is needed.
